ingredients.name: Blended Queso Sauce
items: 150g (1 ½ cups) extra sharp cheddar cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Dice bell peppers and the onion, spread on a baking sheet, and roast for 20-25 minutes until softened and lightly browned.

Meanwhile, prep the chicken: dice the chicken breast and add to the slow cooker with red enchilada sauce, green chiles, fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic purée, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne. Stir to coat. Add roasted vegetables. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours until tender.
highlights: red enchilada sauce, green chiles, fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic purée, onion powder, salt, black pepper

instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add pasta, cook halfway, then drain and set aside.
For the queso sauce, shred the cheddar cheese and blend with 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, cheddar powder, red enchilada sauce, and milk until smooth.
highlights: 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, cheddar powder, red enchilada sauce

instructions.text: When the chicken is done, shred slightly in the slow cooker. Add half-cooked pasta and queso sauce, stirring to coat. Cover and cook on low for 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens and pasta is tender. Divide into 10 servings, garnish with cilantro, and let leftovers cool before freezing.

ingredients.name: Peanut Miso Sauce
items: Red chili flakes, black pepper & sesame seeds to taste
Splash of bone broth or water

ingredients.name: Rice
items: 480g (2 ½ cups) short grain rice (dry weight)

instructions.text: Prepare the peanut miso sauce by combining peanut butter, white miso paste, soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, ginger purée, garlic purée, red chili flakes, black pepper, and sesame seeds in a bowl. Mix until a smooth paste forms.
highlights: peanut butter, white miso paste, soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, ginger purée, garlic purée, red chili flakes, black pepper, and sesame seeds

instructions.text: Add the chicken thighs to the slow cooker. Pour in half of the peanut miso sauce and a splash of chicken bone broth or water to thin it slightly. Mix to coat the chicken evenly.
Cover the slow cooker and cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 4-5 hours, until the chicken is tender and fully cooked.
Once the chicken is done, add the remaining peanut miso sauce and stir thoroughly to combine, ensuring the chicken is coated in the rich, flavorful sauce.

Meanwhile, cook the short grain rice according to package instructions and fluff with a fork. Mix the rice into the chicken or keep separate for portioning. Chop the green onions to garnish the meal along with sesame seeds, divide into 7 servings and store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.

recipes.title: Pineapple Teriyaki Pulled Pork Rice Bowls

ingredients.name: Low-Cal Yum Yum Sauce
items: Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste

ingredients.name: Rice
items: 500g (2.5 cups) short grain or sushi rice

instructions.text: Cut the pork loin into four large pieces and place them in the slow cooker. Dice the pineapple, grate the ginger and garlic, and add to the slow cooker with the soy sauce, mirin, and honey. Stir to coat the pork evenly. Cook on high for 3–4 hours or low for 4–5 hours, until the pork is tender and easily shredded.
Once cooked, shred the pork with two forks in the slow cooker.
Prepare the cornstarch slurry by mixing cornstarch with cold water. Gradually stir the slurry into the slow cooker, until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency.
Prepare the short grain rice. Cook according to package instructions. Once cooked, fluff with a fork.
To make the low-cal Yum Yum sauce, whisk together the low-fat mayo, 0% Greek yogurt, ketchup, sriracha, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Add 1% milk as needed until desired consistency is reached.
highlights: low-fat mayo, 0% Greek yogurt, ketchup, sriracha

instructions.text: To assemble the bowls, divide the rice evenly among 10 servings. Top each bowl with the pulled pork, drizzle with the Yum Yum sauce and garnish with green onions. store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.

Add chicken thighs, green enchilada sauce, Hatch green chiles, diced white onion, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and a dash of black pepper to the slow cooker. Stir everything together to evenly coat the chicken with the sauce and seasonings. Cover the slow cooker and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours, until the chicken is tender and fully cooked.
highlights: chicken thighs, green enchilada sauce, Hatch green chiles, diced white onion, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and a dash of black pepper

instructions.text: When the chicken is done cooking, pour chicken bone broth into a pot and bring to a boil. Once broth is boiling, pour in the jasmine rice and let boil for 10 minutes uncovered.
Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker, mixing it into the flavorful sauce. Add in jasmine rice and bone broth mixture (the bone broth should be essentially entirely absorbed in the rice)
Add the honey, chopped cilantro, and 0% Greek yogurt to the shredded chicken and rice, stirring until well combined and cover for 20-30 minutes. Divide into 10 portions.

ingredients.name: Rice
items: 400g (2 cups) (uncooked weight) of any rice of choice

instructions.text: Place the chicken thighs into the slow cooker. Add taco seasoning, lime juice, chicken bouillon, green enchilada sauce, garlic, and salt to taste. Stir to coat evenly. Cover and cook on high for 2–3 hours or low for 3–4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easy to shred.
highlights: taco seasoning, lime juice, chicken bouillon, green enchilada sauce, garlic

instructions.text: Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker with two fork.s
Cook rice according to packaging instructions.
While the rice cooks, prepare the pico de gallo by combining diced tomatoes, jalapeños, onions, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
highlights: diced tomatoes, jalapeños, onions, cilantro, lime juice

instructions.text: Once the rice is cooked, mix into the slow cooker with the shredded chicken, then add Greek yogurt, reduced-fat cheddar cheese, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, and the prepared pico de gallo to the slow cooker. Stir thoroughly until all the ingredients are evenly mixed and the cheese has melted into the mixture. Let cool to thicken.
highlights: Greek yogurt, reduced-fat cheddar cheese, reduced-fat mozzarella cheese

instructions.text: To assemble, lay one of 18 tortillas flat, spoon a portion of the chicken and rice mixture onto it, and roll tightly, folding in the sides. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Wrap each burrito individually in foil to freeze.

ingredients.name: Pasta
items: 360g (1 ½ cups) pasta water for slow cooker

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and chop the sundried tomatoes and mix in a bowl balsamic vinegar, onion powder, black pepper, salt, red chili flakes. Place the chicken thighs in the slow cooker and pour the mixture over them, ensuring even coating. Cover and cook on high for 3–4 hours or low for 4–5 hours until the chicken is tender.
highlights: balsamic vinegar, onion powder, black pepper, salt, red chili flakes

instructions.text: While the chicken cooks, cut the spinach and basil into bite-sized pieces. Blanch them in boiling water for one minute, then transfer to an ice bath, drain, and set aside.

Once the chicken is cooked, shred it directly in the slow cooker. Add the blanched spinach & basil, feta cheese, and pesto, stirring well to combine. Cover and cook on high while prepping sauce and pasta.
Blend the 2% cottage cheese and 1% milk until smooth to create the cheese sauce.
Cook the bow tie pasta until it's halfway done according to package instructions. Reserve 1.5 cups of pasta water before draining.

To the slow cooker, stir in the partially cooked pasta, pasta water, and cheese sauce, mixing thoroughly. Cover and cook on high for 15 minutes, or until the pasta is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to settle. Divide into 10 servings. Allow leftovers to cool completely before sealing them in freezer-safe, airtight containers.

ingredients.name: Garlic Chicken
items: 2 tsp Kinder roasted Garlic brown butter seasoning

instructions.text: Make the Garlic chicken: Dice the chicken breasts and grate the Parmigiano Reggiano. Add to the slow cooker with lemon juice, garlic purée, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, crushed red pepper, Kinder roasted garlic roasted brown butter seasoning and water. Stir to coat the chicken evenly, then place small pieces of butter over the top. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 4-5 hours, until the chicken is tender and shreds easily.
highlights: lemon juice, garlic purée, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, crushed red pepper, Kinder roasted garlic roasted brown butter seasoning

instructions.text: While the chicken cooks, prepare the blended Alfredo sauce: grate the Parmigiano Reggiano and add to the blender with 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, and milk until smooth and creamy.

Once the chicken is done, use two forks to shred it directly in the slow cooker. In the meantime, bring a pot of salted water to a boil, cook the pasta for half the time listed on the package, then drain, reserving about 1/2 cup of pasta water.

Add the half-cooked pasta, reserved pasta water, and the blended Alfredo sauce to the slow cooker with the shredded chicken. Stir well. Cover and cook for an additional 15-20 minutes on low, allowing the sauce to thicken and the pasta to finish cooking until tender.
Divide into 10 servings and store leftovers in airtight containers in the freezer for easy meal prep.

ingredients.name: Fried Rice
items: 1400g (7 cups) day-old cooked rice (600g {3 cups} uncooked weight)
600g (4 cups) mixed frozen veggies of choice

instructions.text: If using day-old rice, cook the rice the day before and let rest in the fridge until ready to make the recipe.

Slice the chicken thighs in half and add them to the slow cooker. Pour in chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, minced ginger, salt, and pepper. Mix to coat evenly, cover, and cook on high for 2-3 hours or on low for 3-4 hours until tender. Use tongs to break up the chicken when done.
highlights: chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, minced ginger, salt, and pepper

instructions.text: Spread day-old or precooked rice on a large sheet pan. In a bowl, mix soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil, then pour over the rice and toss to coat.
highlights: soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 475°F, then broil the rice for 10-25 minutes, checking every 5 minutes, until crispy and slightly browned. Remove from oven, scrape the edges, add frozen veggies on top, and broil for another 10-15 minutes until veggies are heated through. Transfer rice and veggies and mix with the cooked chicken. In the same pan, spread the egg whites and eggs and broil for 3-4 minutes or until set. Chop eggs and add to the rice, then mix the remaining sesame oil and chopped green onions. Stir well.
highlights: sesame oil and chopped green onions

instructions.text: For the spicy mayo, mix 0% skyr or Greek yogurt, light mayo, gochujang, sriracha, rice vinegar, salt, and pepper, adding water to reach your desired consistency. Drizzle or mix into the fried rice.
highlights: 0% skyr or Greek yogurt, light mayo, gochujang, sriracha, rice vinegar, salt, and pepper, adding water

instructions.text: Divide into 10 servings, allow to cool, and store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.

ingredients.name: Yogurt & Butter
items: 250g (1 cup) plain 0% Greek yogurt or Skyr

ingredients.name: Optional
items: 1 Tbsp sugar or zero calorie sweetener

instructions.text: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Chop and add onions. Cook until caramelized. Stir in tomato paste, garlic paste, and ginger paste, cooking for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Add paprika, cayenne, garam masala, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
highlights: tomato paste, garlic paste, and ginger paste
paprika, cayenne, garam masala, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper

instructions.text: Deglaze the pan with fire-roasted tomatoes and a splash of water, simmering for 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a blender, optionally adding chicken bouillon and sugar or sweetener, and blend for about 2 minutes, until smooth.
highlights: fire-roasted tomatoes and a splash of water
chicken bouillon and sugar or sweetener

instructions.text: Dice chicken breast, then place it in the slow cooker. Pour butter sauce over, ensuring it's fully coated. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours until tender.

Stir in 0% Greek yogurt and additional butter, mixing well. Cover and let sit for 10-15 minutes to meld flavors while the sauce thickens. Meanwhile, cook basmati rice according to package instructions and fluff with a fork.
Mix the rice into the chicken or keep it separate for portioning. Divide into 7 servings and store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.

Grate the garlic cloves and add to the slow cooker along with the chicken breast, olive oil, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, honey, onion powder, and black pepper. Toss to coat evenly. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours until the chicken is tender and fully cooked.
highlights: chicken breast, olive oil, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, honey, onion powder, and black pepper

instructions.text: While the chicken cooks, prepare the tzatziki sauce. Grate and de-seed the cucumber, squeeze out water using a cloth, and combine with 0% Greek yogurt, light sour cream, olive oil, salt, chopped chives, lemon juice, dill, black pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl. Mix well until smooth and creamy.
highlights: 0% Greek yogurt, light sour cream, olive oil, salt, chopped chives, lemon juice, dill, black pepper, and garlic powder

instructions.text: While the chicken is cooking, grate the garlic cloves and mix in a bowl along with the harissa and tomato paste. Heat oil in a pan, fry garlic/harissa/tomato paste for 5 mins. Add jasmine rice and toss to mix. Pour chicken bone broth, salt, and oregano into the pot. Bring to boil, then cover and reduce heat to low for ~20-25 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes then fluff.
highlights: chicken bone broth, salt, and oregano

instructions.text: Once the chicken is done, shred it directly in the slow cooker using two forks. Create a cornstarch slurry by mixing equal parts cornstarch and water (3 Tbsp each). Add the slurry to the slow cooker and stir well. Mix the prepared tzatziki sauce with the chicken, stir until coated. Divide rice and chicken into 8 servings.
highlights: cornstarch slurry by mixing equal parts cornstarch and water (3 Tbsp each)

ingredients.name: Blended Queso Sauce
items: 150g (1 ½ cups) extra sharp cheddar cheese

instructions.text: Trim the flat cut brisket by removing all excess separable fat. Once trimmed, place the meat in the slow cooker. Add the crushed fire-roasted tomatoes, red enchilada sauce, chipotle peppers, green chiles, honey, salt, onion powder, and black pepper. Stir to coat the beef evenly. Cover and cook on high for 4–5 hours or low for 5–6 hours, until the meat is tender and pulls apart easily.
highlights: crushed fire-roasted tomatoes, red enchilada sauce, chipotle peppers, green chiles, honey, salt, onion powder

instructions.text: While the beef cooks, prepare the blended queso sauce. Shred the American cheese and cheddar cheese and combine in a blender with 2% cottage cheese, red enchilada sauce, nutritional yeast (if using), and salt and pepper. Blend until smooth. If the mixture is too thick to blend, lightly heat the ingredients in a pan or microwave until warm (do not overheat), then blend again. Set aside.
highlights: 2% cottage cheese, red enchilada sauce, nutritional yeast

instructions.text: Cook the pasta until halfway done according to package instructions, then drain and set aside.

Once the beef is done, remove it from the slow cooker and shred or chop it with two forks. Return the shredded beef to the slow cooker and mix it with the cooking liquid. Add the blended queso sauce and the half-cooked pasta to the slow cooker. Stir to combine, ensuring everything is evenly coated. Cover and cook on high for 15–20 minutes, or until the sauce thickens and the pasta is fully cooked.
Add chopped cilantro, stir well to incorporate all the flavors. Divide into 10 servings. Store leftovers in airtight, freezer safe containers once cooled.
Dice chicken breast and add to a slow cooker with tomatillos, cilantro stems, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, avocado oil, and lemon juice. Mix and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours.
highlights: tomatillos, cilantro stems, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, avocado oil, and lemon juice

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). De-seed poblanos and jalapeños, then roast with cloves of garlic for 30-35 minutes until lightly charred. Once cooled, peel skin off of poblanos.
Blend roasted peppers, garlic, 0% Greek yogurt, cilantro leaves, 1% milk, lemon juice, avocado, salt, and pepper until smooth.
highlights: 0% Greek yogurt, cilantro leaves, 1% milk, lemon juice, avocado, salt, and pepper

instructions.text: Cook rice according to package instructions.
When chicken is done, leave cubed or shred. Pour poblano avocado sauce over the chicken in the slow cooker and mix.
Serve by dividing rice into 9 portions, topping with chicken and sauce. Store frozen or enjoy immediately.

ingredients.name: BBQ Chicken
items: 700g (4 ½ cups) fresh pineapple (1 whole pineapple)
Garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper, to taste

instructions.text: Grate the ginger and mix in a large bowl, whisk together sugar-free BBQ sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper until smooth. Cut the fresh pineapple into bite- sized chunks. Place the chicken thighs and pineapple chunks into the slow cooker. Pour the prepared marinade over the chicken and pineapple, stirring to coat evenly. Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 4-5 hours, until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
highlights: sugar-free BBQ sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper

instructions.text: Once cooking is complete, add a cornstarch slurry (3 Tbsp corn starch mixed with 3 Tbsp cold water), stirring until smooth to thicken. Lightly shred the cooked chicken using two forks, leaving some larger pieces intact for texture. Mix in additional barbecue sauce and green onions
Cook the rice according to package instructions. Fluff with a fork and divide the rice and Hawaiian BBQ chicken into 10 servings.

ingredients.name: Steak & Sauce
items: 900g (32oz) flank steak or lean steak of choice

ingredients.name: Cheese Sauce
items: 300g (1 ¼ cups) plain 0% skyr or Greek yogurt
Red chili flakes and chives, for garnish

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Enclose the shallot and garlic in aluminum foil and roast for 15-30 minutes until softened (or pan fry)

De-stem and de-seed the guajillo and chile de arbol peppers and microwave for 20 seconds (or toast on dry pan for 30-45 seconds). Then, in a blender, combine roasted shallot, garlic, fire-roasted tomatoes, guajillo, chile de arbol, soy sauce, honey, salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
highlights: fire-roasted tomatoes, guajillo, chile de arbol, soy sauce, honey, salt, onion powder, paprika

instructions.text: Cut the flank steak or lean steak of choice into evenly sized cubes and add to the slow cooker, pour the blended sauce over it, and stir. Cover and cook on high for 4-5 hours or low for 5-6 hours until tender.
highlights: flank steak or lean steak of choice

instructions.text: Cook the rigatoni for half the package time, then drain. Grate the Parmigiano Reggiano and add to the slow cooker with goat cheese, skyr (or 0% Greek yogurt), and 1% milk. Add the half-cooked pasta and stir well. Cover and cook on low for 20-25 minutes until the sauce thickens and the pasta is tender.
highlights: goat cheese, skyr (or 0% Greek yogurt), and 1% milk

instructions.text: Divide into 10 servings, garnish with red chili flakes and chives. Freeze leftovers in airtight containers.

Dice onions and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until translucent and beginning to brown, stirring occasionally. Add olive oil, minced garlic, and tomato paste, mixing well to coat the onions. Cook until the mixture begins to caramelize, about 8-10 minutes.
highlights: olive oil, minced garlic, and tomato paste

instructions.text: Stir in the fire-roasted diced tomatoes and simmer until most of the liquid has reduced, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a blender. Add oregano, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, apple cider vinegar, and chipotle peppers in adobo. Blend until completely smooth.
highlights: oregano, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, apple cider vinegar, and chipotle peppers in adobo

instructions.text: Cut chicken breast into large chunks and place in the slow cooker with the chicken thighs. Pour ¾ of the blended sauce over the chicken, reserving the rest. Stir to coat the chicken evenly. Add 3 bay leaves on top. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours, until the chicken is tender.

Blend bone broth, water, cilantro stems, minced garlic, jalapeño, avocado oil, and salt. Add mixture to short- grain rice in a bowl over a stovetop. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let sit for 5 minutes.
highlights: bone broth, water, cilantro stems, minced garlic, jalapeño, avocado oil

instructions.text: Remove bay leaves, shred the chicken in the slow cooker, and stir in the reserved sauce. Adjust seasoning if needed. Make 7 bowls by spreading rice, chicken, and a sprinkle of cotija and cilantro.

ingredients.name: Low-Cal Yum Yum Sauce
items: Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste

ingredients.name: Rice
items: 480g (2.5 cups) short grain or sushi rice, dry weight

instructions.text: Place the chicken thighs in the slow cooker. Pour in the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, mirin, ginger paste, and garlic paste, stirring to coat the chicken evenly.
highlights: soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, mirin, ginger paste, and garlic paste

instructions.text: Cover and cook on high for 4-5 hours or low for 5+ hours until tender. Once done, lightly shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker to mix with the sauce.
In a small bowl, combine cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then add it to the slow cooker. Stir well and let the mixture sit uncovered for 15-20 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken.
While the sauce thickens, cook short-grain or sushi rice according to package instructions. Fluff with a fork once done.

In a separate bowl, make the Yum Yum sauce by combining low-fat mayo, 0% Greek yogurt, and sriracha. Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of garlic powder, then gradually add milk until the sauce reaches your preferred consistency.
highlights: low-fat mayo, 0% Greek yogurt, and sriracha. Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of garlic powder, then gradually add milk

instructions.text: Mix the cooked rice into the chicken in the slow cooker, or keep them separate for easier portioning. Add chopped green onions, reserving some for garnish if desired.
Divide into 8 servings and top each with Yum Yum sauce. Store any leftovers frozen.

Dice the chicken breast and add to the slow cooker with adobo sauce, minced chipotle peppers, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon, and water. Stir well to ensure the chicken is evenly coated with the seasonings and sauce. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or on low for 4-5 hours until the chicken is fully cooked and tender enough to shred easily.
highlights: adobo sauce, minced chipotle peppers, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon, and water

instructions.text: While the chicken is cooking, cook the pasta half way according to box instructions.

Once the chicken is done, use two forks to shred it directly in the slow cooker. Grate the Parmigiano Reggiano. In a blender, combine the Parmigiano Reggiano, 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, mozzarella, honey, milk, salt, and pepper to create the blended cheese sauce.
highlights: 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, mozzarella, honey, milk, salt, and pepper

instructions.text: In the slow cooker, add the half-cooked pasta along with about half a cup of reserved pasta water to help the sauce reach a smooth consistency. Pour in the blended cheese sauce, and stir thoroughly to ensure that the pasta and chicken are well-coated.

Cover the slow cooker again and cook on low for an additional 20-30 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken and for the pasta to finish cooking until perfectly tender. During this time, the pasta will absorb the sauce flavors, creating a rich, cohesive dish.

Once done, give it a final stir to mix everything evenly. Serve and garnish each portion with freshly chopped chives for a pop of color and added flavor. Divide into 10 servings and store leftovers in airtight containers for freezing to maintain freshness.

ingredients.name: Harissa Sauce
items: 2 tsp each: smoked paprika, dried thyme, dried oregano

ingredients.name: Lazy Tzatziki
items: Salt and garlic powder, to taste

instructions.text: Dice the yellow onions, chop the sundried tomatoes, and place in the slow cooker with the chicken thighs, harissa paste, tomato paste, honey, smoked paprika, dried thyme, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper into a slow cooker. Stir to coat the chicken evenly with the mixture. Cover and cook on high for 3–4 hours or low for 4–5 hours, until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
highlights: chicken thighs, harissa paste, tomato paste, honey, smoked paprika, dried thyme, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper

instructions.text: Once the chicken is cooked, shred it directly in the slow cooker using two forks. Add the juice and zest of two lemons, additional harissa paste, and crumbled feta cheese. Stir to combine, then cover and let cook on high for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
highlights: juice and zest of two lemons, additional harissa paste, and crumbled feta cheese

instructions.text: Cook the penne pasta until it is halfway done according to package instructions. Drain the pasta and add it to the slow cooker along with the whole milk. Stir everything together, ensuring the pasta is evenly coated. Cover and cook on low for 20–30 minutes, or until the pasta is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened.

In a small bowl, mix the store-bought tzatziki with the 0% Greek yogurt. Add salt and garlic powder to taste, stirring until smooth. Chop the chives, divide into 10 servings. Top each pasta bowl with a dollop of tzatziki and a sprinkle of chives before serving. Store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.
highlights: store-bought tzatziki with the 0% Greek yogurt

instructions.text: Add orange juice, chipotle peppers, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, garlic purée, cumin, salt, black pepper, onion powder, honey, avocado oil, and cilantro stems to a blender. Blend on high for 1-2 minutes until the marinade is completely smooth.
highlights: orange juice, chipotle peppers, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, garlic purée, cumin, salt, black pepper, onion powder, honey, avocado oil, and cilantro stems

instructions.text: Place the chicken thighs in a slow cooker. Pour the marinade over the chicken and stir to coat evenly. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easily shreds.
Once the chicken is almost fully cooked through, cook the rice according to package instructions and fluff with a fork.
Use two forks to shred the cooked chicken directly in the slow cooker, mixing it back into the sauce to absorb all the flavor.

Mix the rice with the chicken in the slow cooker or keep separate for portioning. Divide into 7 meal prep containers and top the burrito bowls with 0% Greek yogurt, cilantro, and pico de gallo. Store leftovers in the freezer.
highlights: 0% Greek yogurt, cilantro, and pico de gallo

ingredients.name: Blended Queso Sauce
items: 150g (1 ½ cups) extra sharp cheddar cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Dice the bell peppers and onion, spread on a baking sheet, and roast for 20-25 minutes until tender.

In the slow cooker, combine ground beef, chorizo, salt, paprika, oregano, cumin, black pepper, red enchilada sauce, fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic purée, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, and apple cider vinegar. Stir to coat the meat evenly. Add the roasted vegetables, cover, and cook on high for 2-3 hours or low for 3-4 hours until the meat is tender.
highlights: ground beef, chorizo, salt, paprika, oregano, cumin, black pepper, red enchilada sauce, fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic purée, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, and apple cider vinegar

instructions.text: Cook the pasta for half the package time, then drain. Shred the cheddar cheese and place in a blender with 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, cheddar powder, enchilada sauce, and 1% milk. Blend until smooth.
highlights: 2% cottage cheese, 1/3 fat cream cheese, cheddar powder, enchilada sauce, and 1% milk

instructions.text: Add the half-cooked pasta and queso sauce to the slow cooker, stir well, and cook on low for 15-20 minutes until the sauce thickens and pasta is fully cooked. Divide into 10 servings, garnish with chopped cilantro if desired, and store leftovers in freezer-safe containers.

Add the ground beef to the slow cooker. Add in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, bone broth, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, Italian herbs, and black pepper. Stir well, breaking up any large chunks of beef, until everything is fully combined. Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 4+ hours until the beef is tender and flavors are fully melded.
highlights: tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, bone broth, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, Italian herbs, and black pepper

instructions.text: Once done, break up the oven ready lasagna sheets and add them to the slow cooker. Pour in 1 cup of water and mix thoroughly to ensure all pasta pieces are separated and submerged in the sauce. Cover and cook for an additional 20-30 minutes on high, or until the pasta is cooked through.

When the pasta is tender, blend the 2% cottage cheese, shred the Parmigiano Reggiano and low-fat mozzarella. Add to the slow cooker with the fat-free milk. Stir until the cheese is melted and fully combined, creating a creamy sauce.
Let the mixture sit, covered, for another 10 minutes to thicken slightly.
Chop the basil and serve each portion with a topping of low-fat ricotta and basil.
For storage, divide into 10 servings and let leftovers cool before storing in freezer-safe containers.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Mac n’ Cheese

ingredients.name: Chicken & Bacon
items: Garlic powder, black pepper, & red chili flakes, to taste

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and set aside. Dice the onions and brown in a large skillet. Once browned, add jalapeños (or Fresno chilis) and garlic, cooking until softened. Pour in chicken bone broth, bring to a boil, and reduce liquid completely. Set aside.

garlic powder, salt, onion powder, and cumin to taste

Cook 1 white onion over medium heat in a pan until translucent and beginning to brown

Cover on low for 20-30 minutes or until thickened and pasta is finished cooking

highlights: ground beef, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar-free ketchup, garlic powder, rice wine vinegar, salt, black pepper, and green onion whites

highlights: water, honey, sesame oil, Momofuku flavoring packets (or Korean BBQ marinade) and a pinch of salt

instructions.text: Cover and let sit for 10-15 minutes to meld the flavors. Divide into 7 servings, top with spicy mayo, and garnish with green onion tops if desired. Store leftovers in freezer-safe containers for meal prep.

instructions.text: To a slow cooker, add chicken thighs, diced white onion, red enchilada sauce, chipotle peppers, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and a dash of black pepper. highlights: red enchilada sauce, chipotle peppers, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and a dash of black pepper

instructions.text: Dice the chicken thighs, carrots, Yukon gold potatoes, and onions into bite sized chunks. Pour in the beef bone broth, Worcestershire sauce, and honey. Stir everything to combine, ensuring the chicken and vegetables are coated in the liquid. Cover the slow cooker and cook on high for 4–5 hours or low for 5–6 hours, until the chicken is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.

beef bone broth, Worcestershire sauce, and honey

highlights: Golden Curry cubes (Japanese curry roux cubes)

While the curry finishes, steam and cook the short grain rice according to package instructions. Divide into 10 servings and serve the Japanese curry over steamed rice.

notes: For a lower carb option, serve without rice or use a rice alternative.

jar of pepperoncini, including the liquid
jar of Chicago-style giardiniera (do not drain
salt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and honey
